name: posty
description: Posty: schedule and publish social posts to Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Telegram, Discord and Slack, from the command line or straight from the chat over MCP.

mcp_key.title: Posty MCP key
mcp_key.description: Create one in Posty under Beállítások → Fejlesztők → MCP. It starts with psty_mcp_ and is shown once. The plugin talks to Posty with it; the CLI signs in separately with posty auth:login.
